about: The download list of the project website, in this order; entries of one platform form one table row, a platform without a shown entry is left out. The website's updater (update_site.py) reads this file at the latest release tag. kind 'asset': a file of that release, 'asset' = its name with {version} (and {n} for a package release number); URL, size and checksum come only from the release, and 'missing' is shown when the release lacks the file (no 'missing' = entry hidden). kind 'store': a fixed 'url' on an allowed host (Google Play, F-Droid, Flathub, Microsoft Store, AUR, Snapcraft, GitHub, ghcr.io), with its own versioning. kind 'docker': 'image' shown in 'note' at {image}. kind 'build': a text with a link. Texts are plain: `code`, **bold** and one [link text] for 'link' (building, releases, features, readme, docker, arch, download). Checked by tools/site_figures.py --check.
